programme.title: PL: United v Man City 10/11

programme.title: PL: Man City v United 12/13
programme.desc: United Archives 9/12/12. With the Manchester sides one and two in the Barclays Premier League, United visited the Etihad Stadium for another huge derby clash.

programme.title: PL: United v Man City 14/15
programme.desc: United Archives 12/4/15. The Reds were looking for a first home derby win in over four years when Manuel Pellegrini's side visited Old Trafford.

programme.title: PL: Man City v United 15/16
programme.desc: United Archives 20/3/16. United travelled across the city and it would be a local boy who wrote the headlines in his first senior Manchester derby.
